elevation.$description: How high something sits above the page, as a shadow. A component asks for a height by name, as in box-shadow: var(--elevation-raised), and never writes a shadow of its own. Each height's offsets, blur and spread point at the size scale and stay the same in light and dark; its colour points at color.shadow, which the mode answers with a deeper one.

raised.$description: Lifts above a card: menus and popovers, on color.surface.raised.

floating.$description: Floats above everything: dialogs, on color.surface.raised.
